fullDescription:
ScreenNote

Record your Android screen with optional microphone audio.
Review and trim videos before explicitly publishing a link.
Discuss specific moments using comments and threaded replies.
Keep native recordings private on this device until you choose to share.

The first Android recorder supports screen-only and microphone capture, up to 30 minutes or 250 MB locally. Shared clips support up to 10 minutes and 50 MB. System audio and camera overlays are not included. Online links use shared beta capacity and expire according to the selected period.
